  "rationale": "The concept to decompose is the set of REASONS / compliance risks behind declined expenses. Only is_travel_category_hardware_mismatch encodes an actual reason/compliance-risk type and thus qualifies as a genuine facet. With just one facet present, the set fails to cover the main reason categories (policy violation, budget/amount limits, missing documentation, duplicate, unauthorized approver, etc.), giving very low exhaustiveness. Mutual exclusivity is low-to-moderate because several non-facet columns redundantly capture overlapping data-quality/provenance signals; among the facets there is effectively only one, so overlap is trivially limited but the overall carve is poor."
